title: Education
summary: Strong core learning, smaller class sizes, and modern classrooms that give every student the foundation to thrive.
detail: Ketan will push for evidence-based literacy and numeracy programs, up-to-date learning materials, and staffing levels that let teachers actually teach. Great schools start with great classrooms.

title: Mental Health
summary: More counsellors, faster support, and a school system that takes student and staff well-being seriously.
detail: From earlier intervention to accessible counselling in every school, Ketan will prioritize the mental-health resources students need to learn, grow, and feel safe.

title: Safe Schools
summary: Welcoming, secure environments where students, staff, and families feel protected and respected.
detail: Clear, consistent safety standards, better facilities, and community partnerships that keep the walk to and from school safe for every child.

title: Diversity
summary: Inclusive classrooms that reflect and celebrate the many communities that make Ward 12 home.
detail: Ketan will champion curriculum, hiring, and programming that ensure every student sees themselves represented and every family feels they belong.

title: Parent Engagement
summary: Parents treated as partners — with real information, real access, and a real say in decisions.
detail: Regular town halls, plain-language updates, and open lines of communication so families are never the last to know about decisions that affect their kids.

title: Future Employment
summary: Skills, mentorship, and pathways that prepare graduates for the jobs of tomorrow.
detail: Expanded co-op, trades, and career programs, plus partnerships with local employers so students leave school ready for real opportunities.

title: Transparency
summary: Clear budgets, accountable spending, and decisions made in the open — not behind closed doors.
detail: Ketan will fight for readable, published budgets and measurable goals so every dollar can be traced back to student outcomes.
